summary: Iteration 20 features fully validated. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing (order status flow pendente→em_preparo→pronto→entregue, cancel, invalid rejected, not-found, weekly report shape with 7 items, quiosque exit-pin via /api/login). Frontend: All flows PASS. (1) Admin mobile shows only 'Painel' as admin-title; legacy 'Movimentação do dia' and 'PAINEL DA MARINA' NOT present. (2) Staff hub shows staff-balcao-banner when active lancha orders exist; staff-menu-balcao card opens /staff-balcao. (3) staff-balcao: prepare→ready→deliver transitions verified by real clicks (a23ddecb… order advanced through em_preparo and pronto). Retirada no balcão and Entrega na lancha both listed with badges. (4) Client /conveniencia: all 4 status labels (Recebido, Em preparo, Pronto, Entregue) render in list; 20 order-receipt-{id} buttons found; tapping receipt does not crash the screen (web Print.printToFileAsync gracefully handled). (5) Admin /admin-solicitacoes Conveniência tab shows order-prepare, order-ready, order-deliver, order-cancel buttons + 'Em preparo'/'Pronto' chips. (6) Desktop 1280x860: auto-redirect to /admin-desktop, desktop-weekly panel with exactly 7 weekly-{YYYY-MM-DD} columns present. (7) /admin-status: 'AO VIVO' indicator present; tapping lock (back-button) opens exit-pin modal; wrong pin (9999) shows status-exit-error='Senha incorreta.' and stays on screen; cancel closes modal; correct pin (0000) validates via api.login and navigates back to /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: shareReceipt() in conveniencia.tsx handles web fallback: if Sharing.isAvailableAsync is false it falls back to Print.printAsync; exceptions are caught and surfaced via dialog. Safe.
PATCH /convenience/orders/{oid}/status uses whitelist ('pendente','em_preparo','pronto','entregue','cancelada') and returns 400 for invalid, 404 for missing. Good.
/api/reports/weekly returns exactly 7 items with correct date/label/movements/revenue shape and excludes 'cancelada' orders/requests when tallying.

admin-status quiosque exit modal correctly re-uses api.login(cpf5=00000, pin=4 digits) to validate; response is_admin gate ensures only admin pin unlocks. status-exit-error triggers only on failed verification.
admin.tsx header renders single title testID='admin-title' with 'Painel'; legacy copy removed successfully.
staff-balcao.tsx auto-refreshes every ~12s and highlights lancha orders via cardLancha style; button set adapts to status (prepare→ready→deliver / cancel always visible while active).
